PDF.js 6.4.299 (build d0991a0d5)
Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v6.4.299
Copied from the matching locally installed generic distribution in /usr/share/pdf.js.
Included: core module, worker, CMaps, standard fonts, ICC profiles, and image decoding support.
The scripting sandbox and QuickJS evaluator are not used or bundled.
